system.benefit: To find tracks or follow them for one mile requires a @Check[skill:survival]{Survival check}. The character must make another @Check[skill:survival]{Survival check} every time the tracks become difficult to follow.
system.normal: A character without this feat can use the Survival skill to find tracks, but can only follow tracks if the DC is 10 or less. A character can use the Search skill to find individual footprints, but cannot follow tracks using Search.
